sermon.title: Bible Truths Only Cons Disagree With 07/29/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer argues that apologetics puts God on trial, and that the Bible calls itself a book of truth, not faith or myth. Using a simple scientific method, he shows that the whole Bible hangs on loving God and loving your neighbor, that love does no harm, and that Christians may bring Bible truth into public life.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He says “John 17:11” for “your word is truth” (John 17:17) and “Psalm 119 verse 159” for “your word is truth from the beginning” (Psalm 119:160); his words kept, the correct passages linked. He calls Matthew 22:40 “Matthew 20 to 40”. Kept as spoken: “colored boy” and gang slurs in his childhood story (5:49–10:38).
